exposure: gestational age by last menstrual period (LMP)
gestational age by New Ballard scoring (NBS)
outcome: correlation between gestational age assessment methods
cohort: The study included 179 participants (mothers and their newborns) whose gestational age was assessed using last menstrual period (LMP), ultrasonography (USG), and New Ballard scoring (NBS).
finding: First trimester (T1) ultrasonography (USG) is more consistent with New Ballard Scoring (NBS) for gestational age assessment compared to last menstrual period (LMP), although both methods show a positive correlation with NBS.
